children: On September 17, 2026, a Nasdaq Hearings Panel decided to delist the company's common stock. The company completed a September 16, 2026 private placement it believes cures its Publicly Held Shares deficiency and requested reconsideration on September 18, 2026; it must also achieve a $1.00 bid for 10 consecutive days by October 5, 2026. The stock continues to be quoted on the OTCQB Venture Market.
